parameters.help_en: The UUID of the theme. The value must be returned by GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature, and the file must have been uploaded. If the UUID is forged or the file has not been uploaded, the creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 主题UUID，需要是GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature 返回，且文件已直传完成。若伪造UUID或者文件未上传，则创建会失败
parameters.name: theme_id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the theme. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. This parameter is required during creation
parameters.help_zh: 主题展示名，最长 64 字符，创建时必须填入
parameters.name: theme_name

parameters.help_en:
The file source, which affects the backend logic for determining whether the theme is valid. Valid values:

upload: uploaded through OSS.
(Not supported) public_url: provided through an OSS URL that allows public network access.
(Not supported) user_oss: provided through a user OSS URL
parameters.help_zh:
文件来源，影响后端判断主题是否合法的逻辑，当前包含如下枚举：
upload，表示通过OSS上传
（暂不支持）public_url，表示通过可公网访问的OSS链接提供
（暂不支持）user_oss，表示通过用户OSS链接提供
parameters.name: file_from

parameters.help_en:
The type of the custom theme. Valid values:

(Default) template: The theme is a template.
(Not supported) design: The theme is a DESIGN.md file
parameters.help_zh:
自定义主题的类型，包含如下枚举：
（默认）template，表示是模板
（暂不支持）design，表示是DESIGN.md
parameters.name: theme_type

parameters.help_en:
The application scenario, which affects filtering when viewing the theme list in the console. Valid values:

(Recommended) custom: a user-uploaded custom theme with no preset style or information organization structure.
report: a web report that conforms to the DataAgent information organization structure.
(Not supported) infographic: an infographic that conforms to the DataAgent information organization structure
parameters.help_zh:
应用场景，影响控制台查看主题列表时的过滤。当前包含如下枚举：
（建议）custom，表示是用户上传的自定义主题，不预设风格和信息组织结构
report，表示是符合DataAgent信息组织结构的网页报告
（暂不支持）infographic，表示是符合DataAgent信息组织结构的信息图
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The description. The value can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.name: description
